# ECN-2026-029 - Change notice - Machining induction billet heater #1

Revision: Rev D  
Plant: P1, line P1-L3  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L3-IH01

## Reason for change
Performance data reviewed after recent process variability analysis indicated inconsistent billet thermal profiles entering the machining cell. The objective is to standardize incoming material condition by adjusting control setpoints and procedure clarifications for EQ-P1-L3-IH01. The new target billet temperature for Machining induction billet heater #1 (EQ-P1-L3-IH01) is 1235 °C to align with machining and metallurgical acceptance criteria and reduce rework.

Related documents: ECN-2026-022, SOP-P1-L3-01, SOP-P1-L3-02

## Affected items
- Induction heater control configuration for EQ-P1-L3-IH01.  
- Operator and maintenance procedures referenced in SOP-P1-L3-01 and SOP-P1-L3-02.  
- Shift handover checklist entries for line P1-L3 that reference incoming billet temperature.

## Implementation
- Update EQ-P1-L3-IH01 control setpoint and supervisory display to reflect the target billet temperature value published in this ECN.  
- Revise operating steps and acceptance verification language in SOP-P1-L3-01 and SOP-P1-L3-02 to require confirmation that billets reach the target prior to transfer to machining.  
- Conduct a short qualification run under supervision of process and maintenance leads to verify steady-state attainment of the target billet temperature on EQ-P1-L3-IH01. Document observations and deviations in the ECN implementation log.  
- Train operators and maintenance personnel on the revised SOPs and the interpretation of control displays for EQ-P1-L3-IH01. Training records to be filed with plant records.

## Approvals
Approved by process engineering and plant maintenance prior to issuance. Implementation requires sign-off from the P1 operations supervisor and the equipment owner for EQ-P1-L3-IH01. Post-implementation review to reference ECN-2026-022 and update SOP-P1-L3-01 and SOP-P1-L3-02 as applicable.
